description: This file defines constants for test file patterns, boundary test files, and related exclusion patterns for a project. It includes functions to determine if a given file matches specific test or boundary test file criteria based on patterns.

methods.name: isUnitConfigTestFile
methods.description: Checks if a given file matches the inclusion and exclusion patterns for unit configuration test files.

methods.name: isBundledPluginDependentUnitTestFile
methods.description: Determines if a file is one of the bundled plugin dependent unit test files.

methods.name: isBoundaryTestFile
methods.description: Checks if a file is listed as a boundary test file.
